jobs.description:
Gear up for the ultimate part-time job! 🚀
Join us as a foodora Courier. Experience or no experience, we will teach all you need to know! Ready to roll? Apply now as a Rider.
What we offer:
Average earnings of 180kr per hour

Enjoy the flexibility to set your own working hours – work when it suits you! 🕒

Gear up! We’ll provide bag, clothing and other accessories for the job at no cost 🕶️

More than just a ride - join the foodora Rider Community

What you need to have:
Your personal vehicle – a car registered in Sweden, let’s roll! 🚗

A smartphone – to start your city adventures! 📱

The right to work in Sweden, including the following: 

Valid Work Permit (if not EU/EEA citizen) 

Personal Number or Coordination Number 

Swedish Drivers Licence or EU/EEA Drivers Licence (only if you are EU/EEA citizen) 

Swedish bank account

Basic language skills in English or Swedish

👉 Apply now! 

Gör dig redo för det ultimata extrajobbet! 🚀
Bli ett foodora-bud. Erfarenhet eller ingen erfarenhet, vi lär dig allt du behöver veta! Redo att rulla? Ansök nu som Rider.
Vad vi erbjuder: 
Genomsnittlig timlön på 180 kr 

Njut av flexibiliteten att välja dina egna arbetstider - arbeta när det passar dig! 🕒

Utrustning! Vi tillhandahåller väska, kläder och andra tillbehör för jobbet utan kostnad 🕶️

Mer än bara en åktur - bli en del av foodora Rider-gemenskapen

Vad du behöver ha: 
Ditt egna fordon - en svenskregistrerad bil, låt oss rulla! 🚗

En smartphone - för att starta dina stadsäventyr! 📱

Rätt att arbeta i Sverige, inklusive följande:

Giltigt arbetstillstånd (om du inte är EU/EES-medborgare) 

Personnummer eller samordningsnummer 

Svenskt körkort eller EU/EES-körkort (endast om du är EU/EES-medborgare)

Svenskt bankkonto

Grundläggande språkkunskaper i engelska eller svenska

👉 Ansök nu!

We are looking for an Automation Engineer for a global company in Lund. Start is ASAP, 7 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Lund.

Assignment description
﻿
We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to join exciting industrial and process automation projects. In this role, you will be responsible for programming, testing, commissioning, and optimizing automation solutions tailored to various production processes and customer requirements.
﻿ 
You will work closely with process engineers and other technical specialists to ensure seamless integration and full functionality of the delivered solutions. The role combines technical expertise with a strong understanding of process automation, enabling you to contribute throughout the project lifecycle.
﻿ 
As an Automation Engineer, you are familiar with our standards, processes, and our Plant Master, and you play a key role in delivering high-quality and sustainable automation solutions. Depending on project needs, work may be performed at our customer sites, or supplier locations.
﻿ 
Key Responsibilities

Develop and program automation solutions for industrial processes

Perform testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities

Collaborate with process engineers to ensure optimal system performance

Work according to company standards and best practices

Support customers and project teams throughout implementation and start-up phases

﻿ 
This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive and solution-oriented engineer who enjoys working in dynamic project environments and contributing to innovative automation solutions.
﻿
 This role requires fluency in English.

This is a full-time consultant position in Lund through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 7 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Lund.

 Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

jobs.occupation: Senior DevOps Engineer  Mainframe, COBOL & CI/CD - 20604
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for a Senior Technical Consultant to improve development tools and automated delivery pipelines within an organisation with extensive COBOL development on IBM z/OS.
The role combines hands-on technical work with responsibility for evaluating and improving tools, processes and technical solutions. You will work closely with developers, infrastructure teams and external technology providers to establish efficient, automated and quality-assured development and delivery processes.
What You Will Work On
Develop and maintain tools and processes for COBOL development on IBM z/OS.
Build and improve CI/CD pipelines and automated delivery processes.
Integrate development tools with version control and deployment solutions.
Identify opportunities to improve automation, quality and developer experience.
Evaluate new technologies and contribute to technical and architectural decisions.
Provide technical guidance and support to development teams.
Collaborate with internal technology teams and external suppliers.

What You Bring
Experience with COBOL development and modern mainframe development environments.
Good understanding of IBM z/OS.
Experience with DevOps, CI/CD and automated development and delivery pipelines.
Experience with Git and version control.
Knowledge of Linux and Java.
Ability to take technical ownership, evaluate solutions and drive improvements.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
Fluency in Swedish and English.

Meritorious
Experience building modern COBOL pipelines.
Experience with z/OS development tools.
Experience with TeamCity, Artifactory or IBM DevOps Deploy.
Experience with AI-related initiatives in software development.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to join a multidisciplinary development team working alongside mechanical, electronics and software engineers. The assignment involves both improving existing products and developing new mechanical designs, from initial concepts to complete manufacturing documentation.
What You Will Work On
Develop and improve mechanical product designs.
Create and maintain 3D models, technical drawings and revisions in PDM systems.
Take designs from initial concepts and requirements to manufacturing-ready documentation.
Work with tolerances, material selection and manufacturing methods.
Support prototype development, assembly and practical verification.
Independently drive mechanical design activities.
Collaborate with electronics and software engineers throughout product development.

What You Bring
A few years of experience in mechanical design and product development.
Good experience with Autodesk Inventor.
Experience managing drawings, models and revisions in PDM systems.
Ability to take designs from concept to manufacturing documentation.
Good understanding of technical drawings, tolerances, materials and manufacturing methods.
Experience with prototyping, assembly and practical verification.
Ability to independently manage design tasks.
Strong collaboration skills, particularly between mechanical and electronics disciplines.
Professional proficiency in Swedish and/or English.

Meritorious
Experience with Autodesk Vault.
Knowledge of DFAM and design for additive manufacturing.
Experience designing products for low- and medium-volume production.
Experience with 3D printing, CNC machining and sheet metal design.
Experience designing instruments, electronic products or electromechanical products.
Experience with electronic enclosures, seals and IP-rated designs.
Knowledge of DFM/DFA.
Experience with product maintenance, change management and products in serial production.
Experience with injection-moulded components.

jobs.occupation: Electrical & Cable Harness Design Engineers  Several Positions
jobs.description:
Multiply Teknik & IT AB is growing, and we are looking for experienced engineers within electrical design, electrical installations, electromechanical design, and cable harness development.
The roles are connected to advanced products and systems within defence, automotive, aerospace, marine, industrial technology, and other demanding engineering environments.

About the Role
Depending on your background, you may work with:
Electrical systems, schematics, and wiring documentation
Cable harness design and 3D routing
Electrical installations, connectors, and interfaces
Mechanical packaging and installation of cables
Optimization for robustness, manufacturability, serviceability, quality, and cost
Prototype builds, verification, troubleshooting, and production support
Engineering changes and technical documentation
Collaboration with mechanics, production, purchasing, suppliers, and test teams

Your Profile
We believe you have:
A degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, mechatronics, or equivalent experience
Several years of experience in electrical design, cable harness development, routing, or installation design
Experience from cross-functional and project-based product development
Understanding of Design for Manufacturing and Design for Assembly
A structured, analytical, and solution-oriented way of working
Good knowledge of Swedish and English
Experience with AutoCAD Electrical, CATIA V5, CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE, Siemens Capital, ENOVIA, Teamcenter, or similar tools is meriting.
Experience from MIL cabling, automotive, defence, aerospace, marine, or other advanced cable systems is highly valuable.

For several positions, Swedish citizenship and approved security clearance are required.

About Multiply
Multiply is an end-to-end solution provider within electronics, embedded systems, electrical engineering, automation, functional safety, cybersecurity, and advanced product development.
We support customers from requirements and design to integration, verification, industrialization, and lifecycle support. We also develop VisFlow, our own platform for visualization, analysis, and governance of complex technical and operational flows.
Several positions are located in Västmanland and the Stockholm region. Accommodation in Västmanland may be available for candidates living elsewhere.

jobs.occupation: Senior Embedded Software Developer  C & Hardware-Near Programming - 20574
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for an experienced Embedded Software Developer with strong skills in hardware-near programming using C.
You will work in a technically complex environment within the automotive industry, developing embedded software while considering relevant industry regulations and requirements.
Knowledge of electronics and electrical design is an advantage. The role does not involve designing circuit boards but may include technical activities related to electrical systems and production testing.
You will join a growing organisation with a team of approximately 15 people, short decision-making processes and opportunities to influence technical solutions. The environment can be fast-paced.
What You Will Work On
Develop embedded software in C.
Work with hardware-near programming in technically complex environments.
Consider automotive industry regulations and requirements.
Support technical investigations related to electronics and electrical systems.
Work with topics such as signal screens, grounding, power resistors and current circuits.
Contribute to activities involving braking systems and motor control.
Support production testing and final testing when required.
Collaborate with a cross-functional engineering team.

What You Bring
Strong experience in embedded software development using C.
Good understanding of hardware-near programming.
Experience working in technically complex environments.
Understanding of automotive industry regulations.
Good spoken and written Swedish and English.

Meritorious
Knowledge of electronics and electrical engineering.
Experience with signal screens, grounding and power resistors.
Knowledge of current circuits, braking systems and motor control.
Experience with production testing and final testing.

jobs.occupation: Operating Theatre and Anaesthesia Nurses Wanted for Falun and Mora Hospital
jobs.description:
Region Dalarna is seeking skilled Operating Theatre Nurses and Anaesthesia Nurses to join our surgical services at Falun Hospital and Mora Hospital.

This is an exciting opportunity to become part of highly competent perioperative teams delivering safe and high-quality surgical care across a broad range of specialties. You will play a key role in supporting patients before, during and after surgery while working with advanced medical technology and experienced multidisciplinary teams.

Falun Hospital is the largest hospital in Dalarna and offers a wide variety of surgical specialties, while Mora Hospital provides an important regional surgical service in a close-knit and supportive environment.
What We Offer
.Modern operating theatres and advanced clinical equipment
.Opportunities to work within diverse surgical specialties
